relations.subject: Ramchandra Narayan Dandekar
relations.evidence: In 1936, he went to Germany for further studies and received his doctoral degree from Heidelberg University in 1938 for his thesis Der Vedish Mensh.

relations.subject: Ramchandra Narayan Dandekar
relations.role: professor of Sanskrit and Ancient Indian Culture
relations.evidence: He joined Fergusson College in Pune in 1933 as a professor of Sanskrit and Ancient Indian Culture.

relations.subject: Ramchandra Narayan Dandekar
relations.role: Professor of Sanskrit and Head of the Department of Sanskrit and Prakrit Languages
relations.evidence: In 1950, he was appointed Professor of Sanskrit and Head of the Department of Sanskrit and Prakrit Languages at the University of Poona

relations.subject: Ramchandra Narayan Dandekar
relations.role: Dean of the Faculty of Arts
relations.evidence: He served as the Dean of the Faculty of Arts during 1959-1965.

relations.subject: Ramchandra Narayan Dandekar
relations.object: Center of Advanced Study in Sanskrit at the University of Poona
relations.evidence: In 1964, he became the Director of the Center of Advanced Study in Sanskrit at the University of Poona, and served in that capacity until 1974.

relations.subject: Ramchandra Narayan Dandekar
relations.evidence: In 1939, Dandekar had become the Honorary Secretary of the renowned Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute (BORI), and he continued to function in that capacity till 1994

relations.subject: Ramchandra Narayan Dandekar
relations.evidence: From 1994 until his death in 2001, he served as the vice-president of the Institute.
